description: This file defines the EnkryptAIGuardrails class, which implements guardrail functionality for a language model API, utilizing Enkrypt AI's guardrails API for content moderation and violation detection. It includes methods for API interaction, response processing, and integration hooks for pre- and post-processing of model inputs and outputs.

classes.name: EnkryptAIGuardrails
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that integrates Enkrypt AI's content moderation API to detect violations such as toxicity, PII, bias, and policy violations during LLM interactions. It handles API communication, response processing, and hooks for pre- and post- call validation.

methods.name: EnkryptAIResponse _call_enkryptai_guardrails( self, prompt: str, request_data: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously calls the Enkrypt AI guardrails API with the given prompt and optional request data, returning the API response.

methods.name: EnkryptAIProcessedResult _process_enkryptai_guardrails_response( self, response: EnkryptAIResponse )
methods.description: Processes the API response to identify detected attacks and their details, returning a structured result.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status( self, response_json: EnkryptAIResponse )
methods.description: Determines the guardrail status based on whether violations are detected in the API response.

methods.name: str _create_error_message(self, processed_result: EnkryptAIProcessedResult)
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message summarizing the detected violations.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-processing hook run before the LLM call, checking messages for violations, and raising errors if any are found.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Run concurrently with the LLM call, checking message content for violations without modifying the input.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-processing hook after LLM response, scanning output for violations and raising errors if detected.

methods.name: "GenericGuardrailAPIInputs" apply_guardrail( self, inputs: "GenericGuardrailAPIInputs", request_data: dict, input_type: Literal["request", "response"], logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"] = None, )
methods.description: Applies the guardrail to a batch of texts, raising errors if violations are found.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[ModelResponseStream,None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Allows inspection of streaming responses for violations during generation.

methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail implementation.
